tools.name: find_funding_arbs
tools.description: Delta-neutral funding pairs across the perp venues Angler trades: long where funding is lowest, short where it is highest, ranked by the spread's APR (before fees). Each can be run as a funding bot or by the funding autopilot on Angler's Bots page.

tools.name: get_funding_rates
tools.description: Current perpetual funding for one asset on every venue Angler compares (Hyperliquid, Lighter, Aster, Orderly, Extended and more, plus Binance and Bybit for reference), as the 8-hour rate and APR, with the best long/short pair Angler can trade.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Current perpetual prices and 24h change for up to 20 assets (crypto and US stocks), from Binance, Hyperliquid or Lighter.

tools.name: get_oi_moves
tools.description: The perp markets whose open interest (summed across the venues Angler reads) moved most over the last 24 hours, risers and fallers, plus the total change. Rising OI with a price move means new positions; falling OI means positions closing. Markets under $5M of open interest are left out.

tools.name: get_net_arbs

tools.description: Drafts a perpetual order as a link to Angler's trading screen with the order panel filled in (asset, long or short, size in USD, market or limit, leverage, take profit, stop loss, venue). It places nothing: the user opens the link, reviews the order and presses the button themselves. Use it to hand
